method: Direct research on US Chess official 1956 archive and contemporary periodical issue; visual review of Chess Life Nov 5 p2, PDF text-layer review of Nov 20 p3, December Chess Review link identified but primary page unread, ChessBase scoresheet image and biographical custody only third-party. These are source findings and bounded hypotheses, never formal human blind A/B or game-end authentication.

gates.strict_policy_b: ALL relevant processes terminated AND confirmed terminated STRICTLY BEFORE 120 seconds; stdout/stderr independently each at most 1,048,576 bytes EMITTED AND ACCEPTED over entire lifetime
